chunks: "This reward is for the one who performs tawaf around the House until the sun passes its zenith, bareheaded, barefoot, taking short steps, lowering his gaze, touching the Stone in every circuit without harming anyone, and not interrupting the dhikr of Allah, Mighty and Majestic, from his tongue."

key_terms.الثَّوَابُ: the divine reward granted for this act
key_terms.حَاسِرًا: bareheaded, as a sign of humility
key_terms.ذِكْرَ اللَّهِ: the remembrance of Allah maintained continuously
key_terms.طَافَ: performed tawaf, circling the Ka'bah in worship
key_terms.يَسْتَلِمُ الْحَجَرَ: he touches or greets the Black Stone
key_terms.يَغُضُّ بَصَرَهُ: he lowers his gaze in modesty and focus

ai.seo_question: What etiquettes and spiritual qualities are mentioned for tawaf around the Ka'bah?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the manners and devotional state associated with a rewarded tawaf of the Ka'bah. It emphasizes humility, bodily discipline, consideration for others, and continuous dhikr of Allah عز وجل during the act of worship.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "This reward is for the one who performs Tawaf around the House after the sun has passed its zenith, bareheaded, barefoot, taking short steps, lowering their gaze, touching the Black Stone in every circuit without causing harm to anyone, and keeping the remembrance of Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic, continuously on their tongue."
